title: Fearless Faith
story:
A child was learning to ride a bicycle for the first time.

He was excited, but also afraid.

Every time he tried, he lost balance and fell.

Tears filled his eyes.

He wanted to stop.

But his father stood beside him.

He said, “I am here. Do not be afraid.”

The child tried again.

This time, his father held the back of the bicycle.

Step by step, he gained confidence.

Even when he wobbled, he did not fall.

Because someone stronger was holding him.

Soon, he began to ride on his own.

But he knew something important.

He was never alone.

In life, fear can make us feel weak and uncertain.

But God reminds us that He is always with us.

He strengthens us.

He helps us.

He holds us steady.

We do not have to face anything alone.
life_lesson:
You do not need to live in fear.

God is with you, strengthening and supporting you in every situation.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for always being with me.

When I feel afraid, remind me of Your presence.

Give me strength and courage to face every situation.

Hold me steady when I feel weak.

Help me to trust You completely.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What is causing fear in your life right now?

Do you believe that God is with you in that situation?

How can you trust Him more today?
verse:
Fear not, for I am with you.
Be not dismayed, for I am your God.
I will strengthen you and help you.
I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
